2115097787788652999.en_summary: $SOFI CEO Anthony Noto says “we think we can achieve about 100M products by 2030… That’s a 4x increase.” He also sees room for multiple expansion as almost half of every new revenue dollar flowed into EBITDA in Q3. SoFi on track for its best day in at least a year.
2115097787788652999.zh_summary: $SOFI執行長Anthony Noto表示「我們認為到2030年可以實現約1億產品……這是4倍增長。」他亦看到倍數擴張空間，因為第三季幾乎一半新營收美元流入EBITDA。SoFi有望迎來至少一年來最佳單日表現。

ticker_notes.SOFI: 2030年產品目標1億，為4倍增長；Q3近半新營收流入EBITDA
